description: This file is a CMake module script used to find and configure the GLib library and its components for a build system. It checks for the presence of GLib, locates include directories and libraries, retrieves version info, and handles optional components like gio, gobject, gmodule, and gthread.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds and configures the specified package, in this case, PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Uses pkg-config to check for the specified modules and retrieves compilation flags.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates a library file given its name and hints.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds include files or other paths related to a component.

methods.name: get_filename_component
methods.description: Extracts parts of filenames or paths.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Reads file contents into a variable.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Performs regex matching and string manipulation.

methods.name: FIND_PACKAGE_HANDLE_STANDARD_ARGS
methods.description: Standard CMake macro to handle the result of find_package calls.
